job.title: SAP Basis Administrator @ Talent Aquisition Consultant (TN, IN)
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced **SAP Basis Administrator** with strong hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA database administration, SAP system administration, and enterprise application support. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining the stability, availability, performance, security, and reliability of SAP landscapes across development, quality assurance, and production environments.

The successful candidate will have proven experience in SAP Basis operations, system installations and upgrades, kernel maintenance, transport management, system refreshes, performance optimization, backup and recovery, and production incident resolution. Experience working in Application Management Services (AMS), ITIL-aligned operations, and SLA-driven support environments will be highly valued.

This role requires close collaboration with infrastructure, cloud, security, database, functional, and technical teams to ensure seamless SAP operations in a global, 24x7 support environment.

Key Responsibilities1. SAP Basis Administration and System Operations

* Administer, monitor, and maintain SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and related SAP application landscapes.
* Perform daily system health checks, availability monitoring, background job monitoring, and proactive issue identification.
* Manage SAP system parameters, profiles, work processes, RFC destinations, system logs, and operational configurations.
* Support SAP application server administration and investigate system availability and connectivity issues.
* Ensure SAP environments remain stable, secure, and compliant with operational standards.

2. SAP Installation, Upgrades, and Maintenance

* Perform SAP installations, system copies, system refreshes, client copies, and post-refresh validation activities.
* Execute kernel upgrades, Support Package Stacks (SPS), and other planned maintenance activities.
* Support SAP software lifecycle management and maintenance using applicable SAP tools and procedures.
* Plan and execute technical maintenance activities in coordination with application, infrastructure, and project teams.
* Validate system functionality and stability following upgrades, patches, and maintenance windows.

3. SAP HANA Database Administration

* Monitor SAP HANA database health, resource utilization, alerts, and database performance.
* Support database backup, recovery, housekeeping, and capacity monitoring activities.
* Troubleshoot database connectivity, resource contention, and performance-related issues.
* Coordinate with database specialists to resolve complex database incidents and optimize system performance.
* Support backup validation, recovery readiness, and disaster recovery procedures.

4. Transport Management and Release Support

* Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) activities across development, quality assurance, and production environments.
* Import, monitor, and troubleshoot transport requests while ensuring adherence to release and change management procedures.
* Coordinate transport sequencing, dependency checks, and deployment validation with functional and technical teams.
* Support production releases, emergency transports, and scheduled deployment activities.
* Maintain appropriate transport documentation and audit trails.

5. Performance Monitoring and Troubleshooting

* Analyze SAP system performance using relevant SAP monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* Investigate short dumps, system logs, work process issues, failed background jobs, memory utilization, and system bottlenecks.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents, service disruptions, and performance degradation.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the relevant SAP, database, infrastructure, or vendor support teams.

6. High Availability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

* Support SAP high-availability (HA) configurations, disaster recovery (DR) readiness, and business continuity activities.
* Participate in backup monitoring, recovery testing, failover validation, and disaster recovery drills.
* Assist with SAP system restoration and recovery activities in accordance with approved procedures.
* Ensure operational documentation and recovery runbooks are current and accessible.

7. Monitoring, Incident, and SLA Management

* Support SAP monitoring through SAP Solution Manager and other applicable enterprise monitoring tools.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem records in accordance with established ITSM processes.
* Meet defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), response times, resolution targets, and operational KPIs.
* Participate in major incident management, escalation handling, and post-incident reviews.
* Maintain accurate incident records, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.

8. Security, Compliance, and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Perform Basis-related user administration and authorization support within approved access controls.
* Coordinate with SAP security teams for access-related troubleshooting and compliance requirements.
* Follow change management, configuration management, audit, and information security policies.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, ABAP developers, infrastructure teams, cloud operations, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in technical reviews, operational meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

9. Global Support and Shift Operations

* Provide production support in a 24x7 global operating model.
* Work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and on-call support when required.
* Participate in planned maintenance windows, critical business support activities, and production deployment events.
* Ensure effective handovers between shifts and timely communication of critical issues.
* Maintain operational continuity and service quality across geographically distributed teams.

Required Technical Skills and Qualifications

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in SAP Basis administration and technical operations.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Practical experience with SAP HANA database administration and monitoring.
* Experience in SAP system installation, configuration, upgrades, kernel upgrades, and Support Package maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of SAP system refreshes, client copies, and system copy procedures.
* Experience with SAP Transport Management System (TMS) and transport coordination.
* Proficiency in SAP system monitoring, performance analysis, background job management, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of SAP Solution Manager or equivalent SAP monitoring and operations tools.
* Experience supporting SAP production environments and resolving critical incidents.
* Understanding of backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery processes.
* Familiarity with SAP user administration and Basis-related authorization support.
* Experience working in AMS, managed services, or SLA-driven enterprise support environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per year

**Job Description:**

**Shape the Future of Airbus with Us!**

  

By joining the global **Airbus BC (Cross-Programme)** organization as a founding member of the newly created **Airbus PM Office in India** , you will play a pivotal role in operating projects, programmes, portfolios, and performance management to enable efficient decision-making and execution with a high level of **PM standard.**

  

We are looking for passionate talent, whether you want to **develop your Project Management skills toward seniority** or are **an experienced PM Expert ready to mentor and innovate** , to help us reshape the future of Aircraft programmes through PM excellence .

  

Driven by an entrepreneurial mindset and our Vision 2028 ambition to build an autonomous, high-performing PM Team in India, our mission rests on three core pillars:

* **Driving PM Excellence & Global Competitiveness** : Enabling strategic impact and operational standards locally.
* **Delivering Smart PM Digital Ecosystem:** Deploying data-driven solutions and optimizing cost structures.
* **Ensuring Seamless PMBP Experience & Beyond:** Simplifying ways of working across Airbus India and broader BC activities.

  

In this role, you will be directly embedded in the Engineering PM Office (BCXE) , at the forefront of driving PM Operational excellence and PM Digital innovation across Airbus Engineering.

  

You will play a vital role in accelerating the transformation of PM engineering activities by simplifying complex workflows, automating routine tasks, and building a high-tech data ecosystem powered by Skywise, Data Studio, and advanced AI automations.

  

By combining core PM discipline with data analytics and predictive insights, you will eliminate manual friction, deliver real-time operational visibility, and empower engineering leaders to make fast, high-impact decisions. This is your opportunity to combine PM expertise with digital acumen and directly enable the future of aerospace engineering!

  

**Come sharpen your craft, unleash your potential, and build the future with us!**

  

**About the Role**

Are you ready to engineer the next generation of data pipelines, Skywise applications, and AI-driven tools that power Airbus's digital PM ecosystem? In this role, you will serve as the technical engine of the PM Digital Enablement and Analytics Team for the Engineering PM Office (BCXE).

Working in tight synergy with Senior PM Business Analysts, you will transform complex project data into seamless, automated, high-performance Skywise applications (Workshop, Slate, Data Studio) and AI integrations that eliminate manual data crunching and optimize project delivery across transnational engineering perimeters.

  

The **Senior PM Digital Analytics Solution Developer** is the lead technical builder and data engineer within the PM Digital Enablement and Analytics Team, supporting the Engineering PM Office (BCXE) under Digitalization & AI. This role is responsible for taking functional specifications, user stories, and process wireframes created by the PM Business Analytics Solution Leader and architecting them into robust, scalable digital tools, automated data pipelines, and interactive executive dashboards.

  

Utilizing the Palantir Skywise platform (Workshop, Slate, Contour, Data Studio..), Python/PySpark, SQL, and Generative AI (Gemini AI), the developer eliminates repetitive data processing, ensures 100% data sanity, and builds digital solutions that deliver real-time, predictive project performance insights On Time and On Quality (OnT/OnQ).

  

**Key Accountabilities & Main Responsibilities**

* Skywise Application & Platform Engineering:
  + Design, build, and deploy custom applications on the Palantir Skywise platform using Workshop, Slate, Contour, and Data Studio.
  + Construct, configure, and maintain object types, action types, and link definitions within the Skywise Manager to accurately represent project entities (schedules, risks, costs, and gate milestones).
  + Build clean, responsive frontend user interfaces tailored for PMBPs, project leaders, and domain heads.
* Data Pipeline Development & Integration:
  + Write, optimize, and maintain efficient data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to clean, transform, and aggregate data from primary systems (e.g., Planisware, SAP ERP, ARM).
  + Ensure robust data lineage, data quality validation checks, and high query performance across complex multi-project datasets.
* AI & Workflow Automation:
  + Integrate Generative AI features (using Gemini AI) and prompt engineering scripts to automate meeting summaries, action tracking, and predictive delay alerts.
  + Develop low-code/no-code integrations and scripts (e.g., Google Apps Script, AppSheet) connecting Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) with Skywise data layers.
* Technical Quality & Service Delivery (OnT/OnQ):
  + Participate in Agile/SAFe sprint routines, estimate development tasks, and execute user stories defined in the product backlog.
  + Conduct thorough unit testing, bug fixing, version control (Git), and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) activities.
  Maintain complete technical documentation and user guides for all deployed applications and pipelines.

* Portfolio & User Reach: Direct technical delivery supporting the Engineering PM Office (BCXE) perimeter, serving a user base of PMBPs, Project Leaders, and Domain Heads across Europe and India.
* Data Complexity: Management and integration of multi-source project datasets (schedules, costs, risks, gate reviews) spanning enterprise platforms including Planisware, and Active Risk Manager (ARM).

* Experience in dashboarding solution industrialisation and rationalisation ensuring data quality

* Familiarity with enterprise analytics platforms and cloud ecosystems such as Skywise.
Creative problem-solving attitude with fluent English communication capabilities.  

  

**Certifications** :

Agile & Process Accreditations

* PM Processes, Methods & Tools (Autonomous)
* PM Operations (Autonomous)

* Generative AI Essentials & Prompting (Autonomous)
